# Never CPU-read an image buffer through its raw descriptor address

Image buffers must be read through the bus window mapper, row by row.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [ep7 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/ep7-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus PEN E-P7](../cameras/ep7.md)

Large buffers can cross a window boundary, so map each piece and restore the previous window mode before unlocking.

> **What happens:** Camera crash about one second after the shot.

**Symptoms:** [Restarts or crashes when a feature runs](index.md#restart-in-use)

## Observations

- **Physical camera** ([Caduceus for E-P7](../projects/caduceus-ep7.md)): Reading a buffer directly through its descriptor address crashed the camera about a second after the shot. Source: [E-P7 firmware guide](../sources/ep7.guide.md).

**[Full detail upstream](https://github.com/cakelesscoder/caduceus-ep7/blob/0cb1dbcc50595cd87f56648810762ffbbb8e17f3/docs/FIRMWARE_GUIDE.md)**
